title: Structure-Preserving Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Korteweg--de Vries (KdV) Equation
abstract: arXiv:2511.00418v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) offer a flexible framework for solving nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs), yet conventional implementations often fail to preserve key physical invariants during long-term integration. This paper introduces a \emph{structure-preserving PINN} framework for the nonlinear Korteweg--de Vries (KdV) equation, a prototypical model for nonlinear and dispersive wave propagation. The proposed method embeds the conservation of mass and Hamiltonian energy directly into the loss function, ensuring physically consistent and energy-stable evolution throughout training and prediction. Unlike standard \texttt{tanh}-based PINNs~\cite{raissi2019pinn,wang2022modifiedpinn}, our approach employs sinusoidal activation functions that enhance spectral expressiveness and accurately capture the oscillatory and dispersive nature of KdV solitons. translated_title: 面向Korteweg–de Vries（KdV）方程的保结构物理信息神经网络
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）为求解非线性偏微分方程（PDEs）提供了一个灵活的框架，然而传统实现方法在长期积分过程中往往无法保持关键的物理不变量。本文针对非线性Korteweg–de Vries（KdV）方程——非线性与色散波传播的典型模型——提出了一种保结构物理信息神经网络框架。所提出的方法将质量守恒和哈密顿能量守恒直接嵌入到损失函数中，确保了训练和预测全过程中的物理一致性与能量稳定性。与标准的基于tanh激活函数的PINNs不同，我们的方法采用正弦激活函数，增强了频谱表达能力，并能准确捕捉KdV孤子的振荡与色散特性。通过代表性案例研究——包括单孤子等情形……
tldr: 本文提出一种保结构物理信息神经网络框架，通过将质量与哈密顿能量守恒嵌入损失函数并采用正弦激活函数，实现了对KdV方程物理一致且能量稳定的长期精确求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structure-preserving PINN framework for the KdV equation that embeds mass and Hamiltonian energy conservation into the loss function and employs sinusoidal activation functions to achieve physically consistent and energy-stable long-term solutions.
